svg.title: TrueNorth Local Team floor refinishing portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional flooring portfolio concept for TrueNorth Local Team, showing a finished warm-toned plank floor with a flush doorway transition. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
